changes.title: Elastic Load Balancing for Envoy is now generally available
changes.detail: Today, AWS announces the general availability of ELB for Envoy, a new load balancer type in Elastic Load Balancing (ELB) that runs open-source Envoy proxies. Platform teams that run Envoy themselves own upgrades, security patching, and capacity across Availability Zones (AZs). ELB for Envoy takes on that work. Each load balancer runs its proxies on dedicated Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (Amazon EC2) instances with hardware isolation from the AWS Nitro System, so a zero-day in Envoy stays contained to your load balancer.
